North Star: derive compact mechanistic laws for recurrent state correction under bounded resources, and test whether those laws transport across controlled profile/layout conditions without hidden retuning.

Sealed public result: UP-LM6C-prepressure-deficit-law qualified as EXACT_DEFICIT_LAW over all 108 frozen rows. For profiles {deferred_only, layout_only, hybrid_min}, rotations {5,13}, permutations {identity, reverse, rotate2}, and six arms each, writes equaled max(0, pre_countdown-target) exactly and post_countdown equaled target exactly. mismatch_rows=0, write_error range=[0,0], post_target_error range=[0,0]. No policy change or live activation occurred.

Interpretation boundary: the algebraic law is exact on the frozen LM6B substrate. This does not yet establish whether the law is structural under an out-of-support target/countdown regime or whether it relies on the particular arm construction that generated the 108 rows.

Select one next experiment with maximal information value. Prefer an out-of-support or controlled construction test that changes exactly one substrate dimension while leaving the correction policy untouched. Do not change the law after seeing results. Provide: question, exact frozen extension, controls, primary residuals, preregistered classifications, and what would falsify structural-law interpretation.
